title: Without anyone
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：without　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 without 的含义与所引出的成分，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1950 the guide kept the map ① without a word of thanks at the ledge, and everybody in the valley said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of that morning: the map had been left ② without the help of anyone, and nobody had asked a single question. The guide had come to the valley two days earlier and spoke little of the valley he had left behind him.

The guidebook for July 1944 puts it plainer. It was done ③ without a sound, and the traveller who kept the map had found it ④ without the knowledge of his family twice before the winter came; nothing in the valley was ever done without a sound in those days. The traveller wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every day thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the map at the far ledge, meant something else. He said the whole business had begun ⑤ without the want of money, and that nobody in his family had ever done it ⑥ without the children of the house; he was not a man who explained himself, and the valley had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1957 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the guidebook. What the line asked for was that the map be found ⑦ without a light in the hand, and that the names be written ⑧ without the cover of a name. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried without a light in the hand.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1960 she kept the map ⑨ without a word of thanks again when nobody else would, and ⑩ without the help of anyone, she said in 1962, that was the part nobody forgot. She kept the map in the same ledge for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the valley never forgot what had been done without the help of anyone.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. prep. 没有（表时间：without a word of thanks）
B. prep. 没有（表处所：without the help of anyone）
C. prep. 不带（表方式／状态：without a sound）
D. prep. 不带（引出施动者或相关的人：be found without the knowledge of his family）
E. prep. 没有（表原因：without the want of money）
F. prep. 不带（表对象／目的：without the children of the house）
G. prep. 没有（表工具／材料：without a light in the hand）
H. prep. 不带（表载体／处所：written without the cover of a name）

items.q: without the knowledge of his family
without the children of the house
without a light in the hand
without the cover of a name
without a word of thanks again
without the help of anyone, she said

answers.why: without 意为“没有”，此处引出时间 a word of thanks（一句感谢的话也没有），说明那件小小的地图是在何时留下的。
without 意为“没有”，此处引出处所 the help of anyone（没有旁人帮忙），说明东西被放在何处。
without 意为“不带”，此处引出方式或状态 a sound（一声不响），说明这件事是怎么做成的。
without 意为“不带”，此处引出施动者或相关的人 家人全然不知：be found without the knowledge of his family。
without 意为“没有”，此处引出原因 the want of money（并非因为缺钱），说明整件事由何而起。
without 意为“不带”，此处引出对象或目的 the children of the house（没有带上家里的孩子）。
without 意为“没有”，此处引出工具或材料 a light in the hand（手里没有灯）。
without 意为“不带”，此处引出载体 the cover of a name（没有署名）：names written without the cover of a name。
without 意为“没有”，1960 年母亲在无人肯做时又留下了那件小小的地图，此处仍引出时间 a word of thanks。
without 意为“没有”，母亲 1962 年那句话引出的仍是那一处没有旁人帮忙。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1950 年一句感谢的话也没有前后，向导把那件小小的地图留在了崖台。（without a word of thanks）
那件小小的地图被放在没有旁人帮忙，谁也没有过问。（without the help of anyone）
整件事是一声不响做成的，旅行手册上写得明白。（without a sound）
入冬之前，那件小小的地图已经由家人全然不知找过两回。（be found without the knowledge of his family）
叔叔说，整件事是由并非因为缺钱起的。（without the want of money）
他说，家里从来没有人为没有带上家里的孩子做过这件事。（without the children of the house）
answers: In 1950 the guide kept the map without a word of thanks at the ledge.
The map had been left without the help of anyone, and nobody asked a single question.
It was done without a sound, or so the guidebook says.
The map had been found without the knowledge of his family twice before the winter came.
He said the whole business had begun without the want of money.
He said nobody in his family had ever done it without the children of the house.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 without 的 4 种不同用法（时间、处所、方式、原因、对象等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1950 the guide kept the map without a word of thanks, and nobody forgot it.
The map had been left without the help of anyone for three days.
The work was done without a sound, as it always was in those days.
The map had been found without the knowledge of his family twice before the winter came.
My mother kept the map without a word of thanks again when nobody else would.
The whole valley never forgot what had been done without the help of anyone.
